selected_script.angle: Lint and pet hair ruining freshly washed clothes, fixed instantly
selected_script.hook: Freshly washed dark clothes covered in lint

script_record.pain_point: Clothes coming out of the washing machine still covered in lint and pet hair.
script_record.conflict_hook: Pulling a dark shirt from the washer only to find it ruined by white lint and hair.
script_record.product_solution: Dropping the floating filter bag directly into the washer to catch debris automatically.

timeline.scene: Handheld shot pulling a wet dark shirt out of a washing machine. It is frustratingly covered in white lint, paper fragments, and pet hair.
A hand drops the single floating filter (white rim, four blue float domes, cone mesh bag) into the washing machine full of water and clothes.
Washer running. The filter bobs on the water surface, blue domes floating while the white mesh cone spins below, actively trapping debris.
Close-up lifting the single filter bag out of the washer. The white translucent mesh cone is full of trapped gray lint and hair.
Emptying the lint out of the mesh into a trash can, then lifting out perfectly clean, lint-free clothes from the washer.
Light CTA text overlay: 'Make your laundry cleaner today.' over the clean clothes.
